top_signal.title: Looking for small business who needs new Logo and Brand Identification. (University of Fine Arts Project)
top_signal.summary: Hello, Im student of Graphic design (5th year) from Poland and I'm looking for business or organization to create logo for. Topic of project is to make rebrand of existing business, so it's require to have logo already. I could take some big corporations, but why don't help somebody meanwhile. The cost is free, or small amount of money (despite if it will require a lot of work) but not more than 300$. Of course here is my portfolio on Behance. I can also send works in PDF with more recent projects. I hope that I'm not violating terms of subreddit. If you are interested, please let me know in comment or DM.    https://www.behance.net/jakpio        submitted by     /u/dibiduba       [link]       [comments]
